# MailerSend

MailerSend is a transactional email service designed for developers to integrate email sending capabilities into their applications.

Category: Communication. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/mailersend/.

## Actions

- **Create Sending Domain**: Add a new sending domain to mailersend.
- **Create SMTP User**: Create a new smtp user.
- **Get API Quota** (read-only): Retrieve current api usage quota.
- **Get API Tokens** (read-only): Retrieve a list of api tokens.
- **Get Domain** (read-only): Fetch information for a specific sending domain.
- **Get general API resources** (read-only): Retrieve general api resources and information.
- **Get sending domains** (read-only): Retrieve a list of sending domains.
- **Create API Token**: Create a new api token.
- **Create Webhook**: Create a new webhook for a mailersend domain.
- **Delete Webhook**: Delete an existing webhook.
- **Get email recipients** (read-only): Retrieve a list of email recipients.
- **Get email templates** (read-only): Retrieve a list of email templates.
- **Get sent messages** (read-only): Retrieve a paginated list of sent messages.
- **Get SMS Activity** (read-only): Retrieve sms activity logs.
- **Get SMS Inbounds** (read-only): Retrieve inbound sms messages.
- **Get SMS Numbers** (read-only): Retrieve a paginated list of sms phone numbers.
- **Get SMS recipients** (read-only): Retrieve a list of sms recipients.
- **Get SMTP users** (read-only): Retrieve a list of smtp users.
- **Get users** (read-only): Retrieve a list of users associated with your account.
- **List Domain Recipients** (read-only): List recipients for a domain.
- **List Sender Identities** (read-only): List sender identities.
- **List SMS Messages** (read-only): List sent sms messages with optional filters.
- **List webhooks** (read-only): Retrieve a list of webhooks.
